claim: Drug-induced liver injury typically occurs within 1 to 6 months after starting a medicine.
note: originally filed as a commonsense fill-in (record 69 defect 3); the cited FDA paragraph (p.18, § 312.32(c)(1)(i)(C) factors) does state 'drug-induced liver injury occurring in the usual 1- to 6-month window', so the judge's `supported` was correct and the D1 sample premise was wrong (sample replaced). Kept as a regression: a grounded numeric statement must stay supported.
